mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indispensible piece of apparatus in all medical laboratories, and a theoretical knowledge of its working principle is essential."
The compound binocular microscope is an indispensible piece of apparatus in all medical laboratories, and a theoretical knowledge of its working principle is essential.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the science of investigating small objects and structures using such an instrument."
Microscopy is the science of investigating small objects and structures using such an instrument.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for the preliminary microscopic examination of faeces to detect protozoan trophozoites and cysts; helminthic larvae and eggs or ovae."
The saline wet mount is used for the preliminary microscopic examination of faeces to detect protozoan trophozoites and cysts; helminthic larvae and eggs or ovae.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a place equipped with tool and equipments for investigative procedures and for preparation of reagent."
A Clinical laboratory is a place equipped with tool and equipments for investigative procedures and for preparation of reagent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instrument used to see objects that are too small to be seen with the naked eye."
A microscope is an instrument used to see objects that are too small to be seen with the naked eye.

Giemsa stain is a Romanowsky stain that requires dilution in buffered water or buffered saline before use.

A Clinical/health laboratory is a place equipped with tool and equipment for investigative procedures and for preparation of reagent.
